unlisted_practices: Decoupling core application functionality from LLM dependencies so the tool works without the LLM
Adaptive consent for patient data sharing in an LLM-enabled personal health journal

screen.reason: The paper introduces and tests a novel prototype system (AI-assisted health journaling app) using persona-based evaluations and proposes UX/deployment design principles, but does not experimentally test a deployment practice/guardrail.
